Admission Eligibilty Norms: For B.E./B.Tech. admissions in Tamil Nadu (through Tamil Nadu Engineering Admissions – TNEA), the eligibility norms are prescribed by the Government of Tamil Nadu, Directorate of Technical Education (DoTE), and Anna University. The key eligibility criteria are as follows:
• Higher Secondary Examination (HSC / +2) conducted by the Tamil Nadu State Board, or
• Any equivalent examination recognized by Anna University and the Government of Tamil Nadu.
Candidates from the vocational stream are eligible if they have studied:
• Engineering/Technology Vocational Subjects, along with the prescribed related subjects as per TNEA norms.
### 3. Minimum Qualifying Marks (Average of Mathematics, Physics & Chemistry)
• Admissions are made through TNEA counselling.
• Selection is based on the normalized marks obtained in the qualifying examination (+2), and a merit/rank list is prepared.
Some programmes require specific +2 subject combinations. For example:
• Most B.E./B.Tech. programmes require Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry.
• The TNEA information brochure contains programme-wise eligibility requirements.
• Tamil Nadu native candidates are eligible under the state's reservation policy.
• Candidates from other states may also apply but are generally considered under the Open Competition (OC) category unless otherwise specified.
• There is no upper age limit prescribed for admission under TNEA, subject to the prevailing admission regulations.
